original.target_description: Study 1, all retained students, snippets S1–S5 and comprehension measured by mean cloze-test answer accuracy Acc; ANOVA on printed p. 8.

n.sample_role: Snippet-level subject responses/observations across five snippets from 104 distinct participants; repeated observations, not 520 independent participants.
n.exclusions: 255 started; 110 completed; six completers excluded for extremely short code-reading and question-answering times. Final 104 participants supplied 520 observations. Three participants declaring a reading disorder were retained because their data were not outliers. No additional target-specific exclusions reported.

notes:
No F statistic or named effect size is printed for the across-snippets answer-accuracy ANOVA. The p. 8 paragraph continues the Code snippets paragraph begun at the bottom of printed p. 7. This is distinct from the nonsignificant comparison of method-chain/comment variants on p. 7. Original title and DOI verified in accepted manuscript. Replication full text could not be obtained via the publisher DOI route, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and targeted open-access searches; no statistics or replication verdict inferred from an abstract.
Source follow-up: Published conference article, pp.35–52. Rendered primary PDF pages 9,11,12 checked, including exact ANOVA digits. Requested page locator used to select ANOVA treatment statistic. Distinct primary Mack-Skillings MS = 4.685464, p = 0.0882 on PDF p.12. Subsequent prose also prints p = 0.0857. Abstract says alpha 0.1%, body/Table 27 says 10%; ANOVA p = 0.101498. Authors Table 27 marks agreement with original N.
Completion source review (n_o): §6 explicitly identifies the final analysis sample and Table 3 summarizes all 520 responses. The p. 8 target compares mean Acc across S1–S5. Keep observation and participant roles separate.
